title: Mid-Range Soda; Atmospheric Firing Seminar
source_quote:
Mid-Range Soda; Atmospheric Firing Seminar
Class Meets: 2-5 pm October 3rd, 10th, 17th, & 24th
Kiln Loading/Firing: October 17th
Kiln Unloading: October 24th
summary: Four-week hands-on soda firing seminar at cone 6 with firing and unloading included. Bring finished bisqueware; some ceramics experience recommended. $175; minimum 6 students required.
evidence_sentence: Through a curated slideshow, discussions, and guided kiln experience, you'll gain an in depth introduction to this specialty firing technique while firing your own work.
evidence_quote: prepare and load a cross-draft soda kiln, participate in the firing, and conclude the course by unloading and reviewing the results together
bring: finished bisqueware suited for cone 6 firing
commitment: Four Thursdays 2-5 pm; load October 17, fire October 17, unload October 24
